flights.selectedFlightScope: Calendar and timing results are filtered to {flight}.
flights.referenceDays: Published records exist on {count} dates. Eligible operating flights remain unknown; these are not no-flight dates.
flights.referenceScope: The following are route-wide timetable references, not selectable eligible-operator results. Some are unresolved marketing designators; others are known codeshares operated by a different airline.
flights.referenceNotice: This timetable designator may be a marketing codeshare, not the operating flight. Confirm the operating airline, flight number and nonstop passenger service with the airline before checking award seats. It cannot be added as a verified operating flight.
flights.knownOtherOperatorNotice: This marketing flight is identified as operated by {carrier}, not by the displayed marketing airline. It remains non-selectable for this product.
flights.publishedNotice: Expected operation from an official timetable, not a live flight confirmation. Unpublished times stay unknown; recheck before arranging connections.
flights.publicationOnly: Official timetable mode is available without an API key. Live data is not connected; only the listed publication windows are covered.
flights.publicationGap: No applicable flight is recorded in the available publications, or the source needs review. This does not mean the route has no flights.
flights.title: Flight dates
flights.disclaimer: Published flight schedules only. Ask the airline to confirm award seats and ticketing rules; schedules may change.
flights.scope: Nonstop passenger flights, filtered by the selected product's eligible operating airlines. Dates use the departure airport's local calendar.
flights.unconfigured: The date-specific schedule provider is not connected. This calendar cannot yet confirm flights; legacy route and weekly data remain references only.
flights.queryFailed: The schedule query failed. No-flight conclusions have not been made. Retry after checking the service connection.

issue.operator-unverified: Published timetable records were found, but the operating airline is unverified. Product eligibility and operating-flight counts remain unknown.
issue.not-configured: Schedule data provider not connected; this date is unknown.
issue.not-queried: This date has not been checked. Choose Query this month.
issue.out-of-range: This date is outside the supported query window, not necessarily without flights.
issue.provider-error: The provider did not return a usable schedule. This is not evidence of no service.
issue.partial: The response is incomplete or some operating airlines could not be identified. Flights may be missing.
issue.stale: The result has expired. Query again before selecting a flight.
issue.budget-exceeded: The schedule query limit has been reached. No availability conclusion is possible.

flights.noFlights: The fresh, complete route/date response contains no nonstop flight by the selected product's eligible operators. Other airlines or connecting flights may exist.
flights.partial: These flights were returned, but coverage is incomplete; this list may omit additional flights.
flights.localTimes: Departure and arrival are local to their respective airports; arrival may be on another calendar date.
flights.copied: Flight details copied. Ask the airline about award seats.
flights.failed: Clipboard access failed. Select and copy the flight details shown above.
flights.referenceWarning: Historical or partial weekly records are not a date-specific flight check and do not determine the calendar's verified states.

fix.flightSegmentsTooMany: Fix: drop {drop} flight segment(s) — cut the farthest side trip, or turn its arrivals into same-day transfers (under 24h).
fix.flightSegmentsTooFew: Fix: add {add} more flight segment(s) — for example route one long-haul via a connection on an eligible carrier.
fix.stopoversTooMany: Fix: convert {convert} stopover(s) into transfers (arrive and depart within 24h), or drop the matching side trip.
fix.stopoversTooFew: Fix: extend {promote} transfer(s) past 24h so they count as the required stopover(s).
fix.maxDistanceNumbered: Fix: trim about {over} miles — reroute the longest backtrack through a shorter connection or cut the farthest detour.
fix.maxDistanceGeneric: Fix: bring total miles under the cap — reroute backtracks through shorter connections or cut distant detours.
fix.airlineEligibility: Fix: switch leg(s) {legs} to a carrier eligible under this product's alliance/partner set.
fix.oceanMissingPacific: Fix: add a transpacific sector (e.g. TPE–LAX) so the route crosses the Pacific.
fix.oceanMissingAtlantic: Fix: add a transatlantic sector so the route crosses the Atlantic.
fix.oceanMissingBoth: Fix: extend the route into a true round-the-world shape that crosses both the Pacific and the Atlantic once each.

ci.label: China Airlines · important, but not a true RTW product
ci.body: China Airlines Dynasty Flyer SkyTeam partner awards matter for complex Taiwan award plans, but China Airlines does not accept itineraries crossing both the Pacific and the Atlantic — so they cannot form a classic round-the-world ticket. Plan regional award routings instead.
ci.ruleTripped: This route crosses both oceans and trips that rule — see the failed ocean check above.

jx.label: STARLUX COSMILE · watchlist
jx.body: No STARLUX round-the-world award product exists today, and its published airline-partner redemptions center on Alaska Mileage Plan. Revisit when alliance membership or broader partner rules appear.
